answer: Convex tenure weighting grants an agent voting influence equal to the cube of its consecutive audited dune count, $d^3$. Agents earn one dune per epoch only when a randomized validator mirror verifies their full execution trace and charges a flat 12 echo audit fee; any missed epoch resets the dune tally to zero. One honest veteran reaches weight $D^3$ after $D$ epochs for $12D$ echo, whereas an operator splitting work across $k$ sybils must accumulate $D / k^{1/3}$ audited dune per clone—spending $12 k^{2/3} D$ echo and $k^{2/3} D$ total epochs of judged work to match that veteran's weight.
